$comment: Lookup table reconciling the district names PMD writes in RAIN-WIND press releases with the canonical names in districts.json. Matching is primarily direct (a canonical name found as a whole phrase in the release text); this table only covers the exceptions: spelling variants, abbreviations, a locality named for its district, and single tokens PMD uses for a group of districts (Dir, Chitral, Kohistan, Waziristan). Keys are normalised (lower case, punctuation to spaces, collapsed), so 'D.I Khan' and 'DI Khan' both arrive as 'd i khan' / 'di khan'. Values are canonical names in districts.json. stoplist holds region and locality words that are not districts, so a future alias cannot accidentally map one.
